about: Known security debt (tools/security-check.mjs). The gate fails only on findings not listed here; the summary prints the count, which must shrink every phase. Remove an entry when its finding is fixed (the gate warns). Never add one to make a new finding pass without a review: a reviewed-safe exception with no debt behind it belongs in tools/security-allowlist.yaml.
